page: Microsoft Azure E8ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor architecture is x86_64, equipped with a 260 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations.

The instance is provisioned with 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. For local storage, it includes a 472 GB local disk and supports Premium Storage. No GPUs are bundled with this configuration, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show strong single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2166.0 and strong text processing performance. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth remain in the average tier, with a multi-core Geekbench score of 8311.0 and uncached read memory bandwidth of 67.01 GB/sec. The hardware excels at small-model LLM text generation, reaching 268.75 tokens/sec, but exhibits weak performance on larger 7B and 70B models. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads, relational databases, enterprise applications, and moderate data processing tasks.
